description:
NinjaTrader 8 is running on the Windows desktop. You need to set up a Market Replay (Playback) session to practice trading on historical data.

Your task:
1. Connect to the 'Playback' Connection (Connections > Playback Connection).
2. In the Playback Controller that appears, set the 'Go To' date to January 16, 2024.
3. Open a new Chart for 'SPY' (S&P 500 ETF).
4. Configure the chart to use 'Daily' bars.
5. Add an EMA (Exponential Moving Average) indicator with a Period of 20 to the chart.
6. Save the workspace (File > Save Workspace) to persist your setup.

Note: You do not need to start the playback (press play), just set it up ready for review.
